comparison.objective: Select fine tweezers, peel a display film while stabilizing its carrier, dispose of the film, and return tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection, narrow-slot tab pinching, bimanual stabilization, and progressive peeling of an articulated film.
comparison.success_condition: Film is peeled from 115 mm of adhesive and placed outside the carrier, carrier remains controlled, and tools return to holders; partial credit uses 5 mm increments.
comparison.reason: Its central ability is continuous peel-force control on a strip; neither brittle notch fracture by impact nor recovery of multiple free metal tangs is tested.
